title: NSGo game editor agent thread (version 1)
description:
AgentThread is the strict versioned YAML document stored per line of work under .nsgo/threads/<id>.yaml. A file looks like this:

# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://game.nsgo.dev/schemas/agent-thread.v1.json version: 1 id: door-lever-pulls title: Door opens after two lever pulls scenePath: scenes/level_01.scene.yaml sessionId: sess_claude_01 createdAt: "2026-11-26T13:40:00Z" updatedAt: "2026-11-26T14:18:00Z"

ParseAgentThreadYAML decodes it strictly and EncodeAgentThreadYAML writes it back in canonical form so loading and saving a thread file changes nothing.

version.description: Version is the schema version; it must equal AgentThreadFileVersion (1).

id.description: ID is the stable filename-safe identifier for this thread (stored as .nsgo/threads/<id>.yaml).

title.description: Title is the thread's display name, automatically set from its first request.

scenePath.description: ScenePath is the slash-separated project-relative scene path this thread belongs to, or empty for Project · no scene.

sessionId.description: SessionID is the external agent's session identifier so follow-up requests continue the same agent session.

createdAt.description: CreatedAt is the RFC3339 UTC timestamp when the thread was created.

updatedAt.description: UpdatedAt is the RFC3339 UTC timestamp of the thread's latest activity.

requests.description: Requests lists the thread's requests in chronological order (oldest first, latest last).

AgentThreadRequest.description: AgentThreadRequest is one author request and its streamed steps, changed objects/files, and review outcome.

id.description: ID uniquely identifies this request within its thread.

title.description: Title is the short single-line summary shown when the request is folded or referenced in the Inspector footer.

prompt.description: Prompt is the full request text sent to the agent.

createdAt.description: CreatedAt is the RFC3339 UTC timestamp when the request was sent.

updatedAt.description: UpdatedAt is the RFC3339 UTC timestamp when the request last changed state.

reply.description: Reply is the agent's short completion message shown under the steps.

outcome.description: Outcome records whether the request is "pending", "kept", or "reverted".

changesTotal.description: ChangesTotal is the total number of proposed changes in this request.

changesKept.description: ChangesKept is the number of proposed changes kept during review (0..ChangesTotal).

files.description: Files lists project-relative slash paths of files changed by this request.

objects.description: Objects lists scene object IDs changed by this request (used for Inspector footer attribution).

detail.description: Detail is a compact human-readable summary of changed fields/assets shown when expanded.

historyStep.description: HistoryStep names the undo step label in History linked to this request.

historyIndex.description: HistoryIndex records the 1-based undo stack index in History linked to this request, when known.

steps.description: Steps lists the recorded agent steps for this request in execution order.

AgentThreadStep.description: AgentThreadStep is one recorded action taken by the agent while handling a request.

id.description: ID uniquely identifies this step within its request.

label.description: Label is the short human-readable description shown in the thread and History.

status.description: Status is the step's state ("pending", "running", "done", or "failed").

detail.description: Detail holds optional extra context for the step (for example changed fields or files).

historyStep.description: HistoryStep names the corresponding editor History label, when this step edited the scene.

historyIndex.description: HistoryIndex records the 1-based History stack index created by this step, when known.

objects.description: Objects lists the IDs of scene objects modified by this step.

files.description: Files lists project-relative slash paths of files touched by this step.
